codeReview.summary: This fix closes the prior blocking gap. `apps/web/src/components/account-shell-page.tsx` now derives a browser-scoped shared-project summary from the resolved account context and passes it into both management loaders, so the routed account shell no longer renders GitHub or Linear readiness/repair state straight from machine-global CLI scope. The new `browser-shared-project-scope` helper establishes the effective `local_only`/`shared_visible`/`shared_hidden` state, `buildGitHubManagementState()` uses that effective scope to rebuild readiness plus the extension-enabled indicator from real repair issues, and `buildLinearManagementState()` applies the same scoped overlay to connection, local-access, repair, and capability state. The updated web regressions cover the exact prior failure mode on both providers as well as the visible-scope override path, so the fix now satisfies the VAL-CROSS-003 parity requirement that the original feature missed.

summary: Pass. I reviewed the original failed feature and this fix together using the prior fail report, both handoffs, both transcript skeletons, and both relevant commit diffs. The original blocker is addressed: the account-shell GitHub and Linear loaders now honor the active browser scope and fail closed for hidden shared-project states without regressing visible-scope provider details. I did not find new blocking or non-blocking issues in the fix, and I did not identify any additional shared-state gaps that need follow-up from this review.
